g.text: GPIO32 reads the debounced active-low interrupt.

g.desc: GPIO32 reads the debounced active-low interrupt.

g.text: GPIO33 releases KILL during boot and normal use.

g.desc: GPIO33 releases KILL during boot and normal use.

g.text: After saving state, drive KILL low to turn off.

g.desc: After saving state, drive KILL low to turn off.

g.text: Configure GPIO33 as open-drain; avoid a low glitch.

g.desc: Configure GPIO33 as open-drain; avoid a low glitch.

g.text: R803 uses the switched 3.3 V rail so startup does

g.desc: R803 uses the switched 3.3 V rail so startup does

g.text: not depend on firmware asserting an early hold.

g.desc: not depend on firmware asserting an early hold.

g.text: HOST_3V3 must rise within the 400 ms minimum

g.desc: HOST_3V3 must rise within the 400 ms minimum

g.text: startup blanking period; verify on real hardware.

g.desc: startup blanking period; verify on real hardware.

g.text: R804 initially DNP. Verify the ordered LED voltage,

g.desc: R804 initially DNP. Verify the ordered LED voltage,

g.text: built-in resistor and polarity before fitting a value.

g.desc: built-in resistor and polarity before fitting a value.

g.text: The button switches the 5 V load. The armed charger remains available with the screen and sensors off.

g.desc: The button switches the 5 V load. The armed charger remains available with the screen and sensors off.

g.text: ONT: about 0.245 s to switch on.

g.desc: ONT: about 0.245 s to switch on.

g.text: PDT: about 6.5 s held to force off.

g.desc: PDT: about 6.5 s held to force off.

g.text: R203 on sheet 3 supplies the EN pull-up.

g.desc: R203 on sheet 3 supplies the EN pull-up.

g.text: J801 carries only the isolated switch contacts.

g.desc: J801 carries only the isolated switch contacts.

g.text: The separate LED wires go to J802.

g.desc: The separate LED wires go to J802.

g.text: A normally-open contact closes PB to ground.

g.desc: A normally-open contact closes PB to ground.

g.text: OFF: press for about 0.25 s; the converter, Guition and sensors turn on.

g.desc: OFF: press for about 0.25 s; the converter, Guition and sensors turn on.

g.text: ON: firmware should treat a deliberate press as a shutdown request, stop sensing,

g.desc: ON: firmware should treat a deliberate press as a shutdown request, stop sensing,

g.text: save state, then pull POWER_KILL_N low. This firmware is not implemented yet.

g.desc: save state, then pull POWER_KILL_N low. This firmware is not implemented yet.

g.text: A continuous ~6.5 s hold forces off even if the host hangs. Timing has component tolerance.

g.desc: A continuous ~6.5 s hold forces off even if the host hangs. Timing has component tolerance.

g.text: The charger keeps working while OFF only after the commissioning ARM shunt is fitted.

g.desc: The charger keeps working while OFF only after the commissioning ARM shunt is fitted.

g.text: Guition USB must be disconnected for full power-off; do not use its CN4 battery input.

g.desc: Guition USB must be disconnected for full power-off; do not use its CN4 battery input.
